intent_en: To illustrate the high attrition rate of family businesses across generations and introduce a specific chain that has successfully maintained its legacy.
previous_intent: To illustrate the low survival rate of family businesses across generations and highlight a specific chain that has successfully preserved its legacy.
narration_support: Only about a third of family businesses survive the second generation, and another 50 % don't last until the third. In and out is one of the few chains that has stayed true to its beginnings, despite going through several traumatic changes.
chart_support: Split graphic showing human figures representing generations on the left and a business icon with a circular progress indicator on the right, visually linking family succession to business continuity.
evidence_note: The narration provides statistics on survival rates and introduces a specific company, while the chart provides a visual metaphor for generations (human figures) and business longevity (building icon with cycle indicator).
